name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 28 - Am 17
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2024
part_text: 7. Calls on the Commission and the EIB Group to enhance efforts to mobilise long-term savings for productive investments, including support for innovation over the course of corporate life cycles, and strengthening the EU’s leadership in green and digital bonds; underlines that higher-risk instruments such as equity and venture debt, while having a significant policy impact, must be used with clear risk frameworks, strong private co-financing and measurable performance indicators;
